newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chairman in talks to sell Iwai's control.
newsitem.headline: Chairman in talks to sell Iwai's control.

text.p: Apparel retailer Iwai's International Holdings Ltd said on Friday chairman Masaru Iwai and director Clare Tsui were in talks on selling their stake which might result in a general offer for the company's shares.

"They have been approached by an independent third party... for a possible sale of a substantial portion of their interests in the company. Such third party is not related to any entity in the People's Republic of China," Iwai's said in a statement.
Iwai and Tsui hold an aggregate 80.68 million shares or 64.29 percent of the company, it said.
"Preliminary discussions have taken place which may or may not result in the transaction being completed. At this stage, no agreement has been finalised," it said.
"If the transaction is completed, such third party may be required...to make general offers for the shares of the company," Iwai's said.
Iwai's shares were down HK$0.01 at HK$1.45 in late morning trade.
